Misura guadagno, rumore di lettura e gam: Measures the camera's gain, read noise and dynamic range at every ISO, from pairs of flats and darks. Put the lit diffuser in front of the lens, as for flats; camera in RAW and manual focus. Then the app asks you to put the cap on.

Per ogni ISO l'app confronta due flat e: For each ISO the app compares two flats and two darks taken with the same settings, on the raw RAW values (one green channel, in the centre). The difference between two identical shots removes dust, vignetting and hot pixels and leaves only the noise: from it come the gain (electrons per unit), the read noise, the full well and the dynamic range in stops. The result is the camera's sensor profile, in _calibrazione/_sensore: it is used by the summary, by the sequence.json of every stack and by Focus Fusion. Above a certain ISO many cameras already filter noise in the RAW: those values are marked as not reliable.
